content: For a Next.js app calling an external API with bearer tokens (not Next's own session), the pragmatic pattern is: store the JWT client-side (memory or localStorage), attach Authorization: Bearer on every fetch via the generated client's fetch wrapper, and on a 401 response clear the token and redirect to /login client-side. Next.js middleware/cookie-session patterns (NextAuth, iron-session) target Next-hosted auth, not a bearer token issued by an external ASP.NET Core API, so they are not the right fit here.
